playbackTemplateSpec.name: O-Contrabass
playbackTemplateSpec.creator: Ouaricon Audio
playbackTemplateSpec.description: Loads O-Contrabass, a sustained-arco solo contrabass physical model, on contrabass / upright-bass staves. Routing is driven by the endpoint config's instrument list (instrument.strings.contrabass, instrument.strings.contrabass.d, instrument.strings.uprightbass); the empty spec-level instrumentFamilies/instruments fields are vestigial (parsed but not consulted). Microtonal pitch routes via VST3 Note Expression (kTuningTypeID); dynamics via note velocity. NoteExpression-only — no keyswitches. Non-bass staves are not routed by this template (solo-instrument add-on); apply a full template alongside for a mixed score, or assign O-Contrabass per stave via the Mixer.
